❕ Air defense systems destroyed 123 drones approaching Moscow overnight, with a total of 462 UAVs flying toward the Moscow Region. Most of them were neutralized far from the capital, Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin reported. ❗️ Russian air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 1,246 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions overnight, the Russian Defense Ministry reported. “Over the past night, on-duty air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 1,246 Ukrainian fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles over the Bryansk, Belgorod, Kursk, Oryol, Smolensk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Tula, Rostov, Volgograd, Saratov, and Samara regions, the Krasnodar Region, the Moscow Region, and the republics of Crimea and Bashkortostan,” the ministry said.
